menu.about.licenses_body.value: Samaroh is built with open-source software, including: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and AndroidX (Apache 2.0), Material Components (Apache 2.0), Hilt and Dagger (Apache 2.0), Room (Apache 2.0), WorkManager (Apache 2.0), kotlinx.serialization and kotlinx.coroutines (Apache 2.0), Coil (Apache 2.0).
menu.about.licenses_body.description: About screen: license attribution text listing bundled open-source libraries. Library names are proper nouns and stay untranslated.

settings.backup.frequency_title.description: Backup settings: heading above the frequency choices.

settings.sync.pending.value: {count, plural, one {# change waiting to sync} other {# changes waiting to sync}}
settings.sync.pending.description: Sync status: number of local changes still in the outbox.

settings.sync.all_synced.description: Sync status: shown when the outbox is empty.

settings.sync.last_sync.description: Sync status: time of the last successful sync. {time} is a localized date-time.

settings.sync.not_synced_yet.description: Sync status: shown when no successful sync has completed.

settings.sync.sync_now.description: Sync status: button requesting an immediate sync.

settings.sync.verb_add.description: Sync status: operation verb for a newly created record waiting to sync.

settings.sync.verb_update.description: Sync status: operation verb for an edited record waiting to sync.

settings.sync.verb_delete.description: Sync status: operation verb for a deleted record waiting to sync.

settings.sync.entity_payment.description: Sync status: entity noun for a booking payment.

settings.sync.entity_reminder.description: Sync status: entity noun for a payment reminder.

settings.sync.entity_date_block.description: Sync status: entity noun for a blocked date range.

settings.sync.entity_party.description: Sync status: entity noun for an expenses-ledger party (vendor/customer).

settings.sync.entity_expense.description: Sync status: entity noun for an expense entry.

settings.sync.entity_attachment.description: Sync status: entity noun for an expense attachment (receipt photo).

settings.sync.entity_inventory_item.description: Sync status: entity noun for a master-list inventory item.

settings.sync.entity_stock_entry.description: Sync status: entity noun for an inventory stock transaction (add/remove).

settings.sync.entity_business.description: Sync status: entity noun for the business profile.

settings.sync.entity_member.description: Sync status: entity noun for a business member.

settings.sync.entity_business_settings.description: Sync status: entity noun for the business settings row.

settings.sync.entity_google_account.description: Sync status: entity noun for the linked Google account.

settings.sync.entity_record.description: Sync status: fallback entity noun for an unrecognized record type.

settings.sync.error_entity.description: Sync status error row: which record failed. {entity} is the technical record type.

settings.business.type.description: Business profile: type field label (e.g. marriage hall, guest house).
